description: Suggest integrations to connect next, based on what Sequenzy found on the company's website during onboarding: tools on the homepage or the sign-in page it links to (Clerk, Supabase, PostHog, Segment, Mixpanel, Amplitude, Webflow, Wix, WordPress, WooCommerce) or a Shopify storefront, minus anything already connected. Payment providers are never guessed from the site: when the website lists pricing and no payment or commerce integration is connected, `paymentProviders` lists every payment provider so the user can pick theirs. `scanComplete` is false while the website is still being read, so an empty list then means 'not scanned yet', not 'nothing found'. Use list_integration_capabilities to explain what a suggested provider gives and how it connects. Read-only.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

name: list_integration_suggestions

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `list_integration_suggestions` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

paymentProviders.description: Present when the website lists pricing and no payment or commerce integration is connected: reason (pricing_found), pricingPlanCount, and providers (every payment provider, each with provider and name). Null otherwise.

scanComplete.description: False while onboarding is still reading the website, including the tool scan that can finish a few seconds later; an empty list then means not scanned yet.

suggestions.description: Detected providers not yet connected, each with provider, name, category, evidence (homepage, sign_in_page or storefront) and shopDomain (Shopify only, else null).

items.description: One item in the returned collection.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.

websiteUrl.description: The company website the suggestions were read from.
